title: Invalid CSV numbers are coerced to zero
reproduction: Paste SKU,System Qty,Physical Qty,Unit Cost then BAD,not-a-number,not-a-number,not-a-number; import and analyze
expected: Reject row or report invalid numeric fields
actual: Imports successfully; 100% exact-match accuracy; US$0.00 exposure
recommended_fix: Return validation errors for non-finite numeric cells; import should be atomic
regression_test: Invalid numeric field is rejected and no KPI is produced

title: Duplicate SKU-location rows are analyzed as separate items
expected: Reject duplicates or aggregate with a documented rule
actual: 2 of 2 items and 50% accuracy
recommended_fix: Detect SKU plus location identity before analysis; block or flag duplicates
regression_test: Duplicate SKU-location is rejected or visibly flagged

title: Blank required quantities import as zero and report perfect accuracy
expected: Require system and physical quantities
actual: 100% accuracy and zero units variance
recommended_fix: Reject blank required numeric fields
regression_test: Blank system or physical quantity blocks analysis

title: Unclosed CSV quote is accepted as a malformed row
reproduction: Import a row beginning with an unterminated double quote
expected: Reject malformed CSV and identify the row
actual: Row imports with a merged SKU cell and zero quantities
recommended_fix: Track quote state and reject records that end while quoted
regression_test: Unclosed quote returns a row-specific parse error

title: Negative quantities and costs are accepted without warning
expected: Reject negative physical quantity and unit cost unless an explicit returns mode exists
actual: Five-unit variance and US$25.00 exposure
recommended_fix: Validate non-negative finite quantities and costs
regression_test: Negative quantity and cost are rejected

title: Future last-count date is treated as age zero
expected: Reject future dates or flag them
actual: Imports successfully and lowers age risk versus a missing date
recommended_fix: Reject count dates after today
regression_test: Future count date is rejected

title: Monthly compounding omits a final partial period
reproduction: 10,000 principal; 5% annual rate; 1 month; monthly compounding
recommended_fix: Use exact compound-period or fractional-period mathematics
regression_test: One-month monthly-compounding result equals independent formula

title: Negative average demand produces a negative reorder point
expected: Reject negative demand
actual: Reorder point -30.00 and status STOCK OK
recommended_fix: Require finite non-negative demand, lead time, safety stock and stock values
regression_test: Negative demand is rejected with no stale status

title: Negative standard deviation produces negative safety stock
expected: Reject negative standard deviation
actual: Safety stock -31.11 and coverage -2.07 days
recommended_fix: Validate non-negative finite inputs and state fixed-lead-time assumptions
regression_test: Negative deviation and negative lead time are rejected

title: Fractional carton quantity is silently truncated
expected: Reject non-integer quantity or apply a visible rounding rule
actual: Quantity displays 2 and calculations use two cartons
recommended_fix: Parse with Number and require an integer quantity
regression_test: Fractional quantity is rejected

title: Invalid quantity or weight leaves stale results visible
reproduction: Calculate a valid shipment then enter quantity -1 or actual weight -1 and calculate
expected: Clear results and show only the validation error
actual: Prior chargeable and volumetric weights remain visible
recommended_fix: Clear result region at the start of every calculation
regression_test: Invalid input clears all prior results

title: Validation error leaves stale hours and earnings visible
reproduction: 08:00-17:00 with 60-minute break; change break to 600 and calculate
expected: Clear or invalidate prior results
actual: Error appears but 8h 00m and USD 160.00 remain
recommended_fix: Clear result region on every calculate attempt
regression_test: Invalid break clears prior hours and earnings

title: Invalid fixed cost or contribution leaves prior break-even result visible
reproduction: Calculate 10k/100/60/400 then set fixed cost -1 or price below variable cost
expected: Clear or invalidate prior result
actual: Error appears while break-even units remain 250
recommended_fix: Call clearResults on every validation return
regression_test: Invalid inputs clear prior results

title: Fractional total cartons accepted
expected: Reject non-integer carton count
actual: Final pallet quantity shows 21
recommended_fix: Require integer total cartons
regression_test: Fractional total cartons is rejected

title: Fractional total cartons accepted
expected: Reject non-integer carton count
actual: Last container quantity shows 216.5
recommended_fix: Require integer total cartons
regression_test: Fractional total cartons is rejected

title: Mobile table expands page to 610 px at a 390 px viewport
expected: Document remains within viewport width
actual: Document and body width 610 px; wrapper overflow visible
recommended_fix: Contain table scrolling and remove the mobile overflow-visible override
regression_test: No horizontal page overflow at 320/360/390/430 px

title: Large editable table expands the document width on mobile
expected: Document width equals viewport; table scroll stays inside wrapper
actual: Visual viewport 390; document width 1330; wrapper 328 wide with 1336 scroll width
recommended_fix: Constrain grid/flex children and table wrapper with min-width 0
regression_test: No document-level horizontal overflow on a physical device

title: Malformed backup exposes raw JSON parser text
reproduction: Upload a file containing {not valid json
expected: Friendly recovery message and unchanged workspace
actual: Raw parser message: Expected property name or } in JSON at position 1
recommended_fix: Catch JSON parse failures separately and show a friendly error
regression_test: Malformed backup shows recovery message and preserves workspace

title: No skip-to-content link
reproduction: Keyboard navigate any page from the top
expected: Provide a visible-on-focus skip link to main content
actual: No skip link found on any of 64 pages
recommended_fix: Add a skip link as the first focusable element on every page
regression_test: Tab from page load reaches skip link and jumps to main

title: Eight titles exceed 60 characters
expected: Keep titles within a display-safe range after review
actual: 61-66 character titles on eight routes
recommended_fix: Review truncation and search-intent fit; do not shorten mechanically
regression_test: Title remains unique and descriptive after edit
status: Fixed - reduced 15 to 4 over-60 titles; max 66 -> 64; remaining 4 left deliberately

title: Automated contrast scan flagged 181 text nodes
reproduction: Review flagged nodes against computed background
expected: Meet WCAG contrast where text is meaningful
actual: Flags include coming-soon labels at 2.56 and card numbers near 1-2.04
recommended_fix: Manually verify each pattern; many may be decorative or non-essential
regression_test: Targeted contrast checks for confirmed meaningful text
status: Hypothesis; not a confirmed WCAG failure
